how.meta.title: How progress works: XP, ranks and streaks · Profit.com Academy
how.meta.description: How XP, levels and the five ranks work in the Profit.com Academy, plus Chapter Challenges, Profit Coins, certificates, streaks and the Top Learners board.
how.title: How progress works
how.lead: Learn in short lessons, prove it in Chapter Challenges and earn XP. Each rank is a step in learning to trade, and Rico gets a new look at every one.
how.ranks.title: Five ranks
how.you.label: You
how.levels.note: Ranks never go down. After level {n}, every level takes {step} XP.
how.xp.title: Earn XP
how.xp.note: Pass a Chapter Challenge after a failed try and it gives half XP. XP is paid once: replaying a finished lesson or a passed Challenge gives none.
how.skills.title: Earn skills
how.skills.lead: Ranks show how far you've come. Skills show what you can do, and you unlock each one by proving it.
how.skills.note: Unlocked skills show on your profile.
how.finish.title: Finish a path
how.finish.howText: Pass every Chapter Challenge and write your trading plan.
how.finish.coinsNote: Coins buy Market Game lives, free tournament entries and Rico accessories. They have no cash value.
how.loop.title: How learning works
how.loop.1.title: Short lessons
how.loop.1.text: Rico explains an idea in a few cards, then you try it and answer 3 quick questions.
how.loop.2.title: Rico's Gym
how.loop.2.text: Questions you miss come back until you get them right. Get one right on 2 different days and it's mastered.
how.loop.3.title: Chapter Challenge
how.loop.3.text: A short quiz at the end of each chapter: one question per lesson, in new situations. Miss at most one to unlock the next chapter.
how.loop.4.title: Finish the path
how.loop.4.text: Pass every Challenge, get your personal trading plan and collect your certificate.
how.faq.title: Common questions
how.faq.1.q: Can I lose XP or my rank?
how.faq.1.a: No. XP only goes up. Only the monthly Top Learners board resets, on the 1st.
how.faq.2.q: Can I buy XP or a rank?
how.faq.2.a: No. Rank looks are earned only. Coins buy game lives, tournament entries and accessories, never progress.
how.faq.3.q: What if I fail a Chapter Challenge?
how.faq.3.a: Nothing is lost. Take a quick refresher and retry with new questions, as often as you like.
how.faq.4.a: Meet your daily goal (1, 2 or 4 lessons, a Gym session counts too) and your streak grows by a day. 7, 30, 100 and 365 days earn +100, +250, +500 and +1,000 XP.
how.faq.5.q: What if I miss a day?
how.faq.5.a: A streak freeze covers it. You earn one for every 7 days in a row and can hold 2. Weekend mode, in Settings, means Saturdays and Sundays never break your streak.
how.faq.6.a: It ranks the XP everyone earned this calendar month and starts again on the 1st. You can hide yourself from it in Settings.
